note: Hard conversation tools: separate the three conversations, decline cleanly, deliver feedback, and listen past the four failures
Meeting and decision tools: name the decision, optimize recurring meetings, and write the follow-up that drives action
Persuasion tools: structure the argument answer-first, tell the story, and brief the creative work that carries the message
Negotiation tools: prepare the BATNA and offers, build the proposal, and manage the scope changes that follow
Managing up: frame in the manager's terms, write for action, and run the meeting that lands the decision
Cross-cultural tools: map the dimensions, listen for what you miss, and navigate the hard conversation across difference
Sales and influence: tell the story, prepare the negotiation, and codify the approach in the sales playbook
Clarity tools: action-first writing and answer-first presenting share the same discipline of leading with the point
Boundary and upward tools: decline a request cleanly and shape what you take to your manager
